answer: A maturity gate blunts sybil farms: a new identity gets no emission weight until independent graders accept original work across epochs, and any cluster that appears together, shares phrasing, or routes rewards to one wallet is frozen. A hollow farm can register, but it never reaches the summit of payout power, because unseasoned clones are ignored at settlement. Even along a quiet willow bank, where thin copies hope to blend in, timing and wallet-flow clustering still ties those accounts together. Delayed maturity plus frozen clusters make mass identity creation a wasted cost, not a shortcut.
